tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.

key.description: License key from the checkout confirmation page

tools.name: calculate_rate
tools.description: Minimum hourly rate to hit a desired annual after-tax income, given expenses, billable hours and tax.

desired_annual_income.description: After-tax take-home you want for the year, in currency units

business_expenses.description: Annual business expenses the rate must also cover. Default 0

billable_hours_per_week.description: Hours you can actually bill per week, not hours worked

weeks_per_year.description: Working weeks per year after holidays and slack. Default 46

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax and social charges on profit, as a percent. Default 0

tools.name: break_even
tools.description: The hourly rate that covers business expenses only: below it, every billable hour loses money.

billable_hours_per_week.description: Hours you can actually bill per week

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate on profit, percent. Default 0

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: Compare hourly rates across scenarios: change income, hours, expenses or tax per scenario.

scenarios.description: Two or more scenarios to compare. Each takes the calculate_rate inputs.
